entities.name: Kodama of the East Tree
entities.description: Kami of the Spring Tree of the Jukai on Kamigawa that values growth above all else.

entities.name: Jukai
entities.description: Forest on Kamigawa containing the Five Trees.

entities.name: Spring Tree
entities.description: One of the Five Trees, home of the Kodama of the East Tree.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: Twenty-year war during which the Kodama went dormant and spread its roots.

entities.name: Monks of the East Tree
entities.description: Monks who prospered beside the Kodama and now pray to it from a distance.

events.summary: When the Kami War breaks out, the Kodama appears to go dormant but spreads its roots through the East Tree territory.
events.quote: When the Kami War broke out, the Kodama appeared to go dormant

events.summary: New spores burst from the ground and siphon energy from humans to create spiritual growths.
events.quote: latching onto humans and siphoning their energy to create new spiritual growths

events.summary: At the end of the war the Kodama sinks into dormancy again.
events.quote: At the end of the twenty-year war, the Kodama sank into dormancy once more.

relations.note: It is the kami of the Spring Tree in Jukai forest.
relations.quote: The Kodama of the East Tree is the kami of the Spring Tree in Jukai forest

relations.note: The monks pray to it nervously from a safe distance.
relations.quote: the remaining monks still pray to it nervously - from a safe distance
